home.subhead: For studios, clinics, fitness centers, driving schools, and every service business. Your clients stay yours — no booking fees, no marketplace. Just fair software.
home.socialProof: Reserved is used by 250+ studios, clinics, and fitness centers
home.featuresSub: From online bookings to client database, payments, and marketing. One system, fully localized.
home.compareHeadline: Why Reserved instead of Booksy or Fresha?
home.compareSub: We're the fair alternative. Your clients are yours, not a marketplace's.
home.ctaBigSub: Set up in 5 minutes. 14-day trial without a credit card. If you don't like it, just walk away.

onlineBooking.title: Online bookings 24/7
onlineBooking.text: Clients book via your website or directly at reserved.cz. Drag-and-drop calendar with day, week, and month views.

crm.title: Client CRM
crm.text: Visit history, notes, tags, no-show tracking. See who's VIP and who prefers a specific staff member.

payments.title: Card payments + QR
payments.text: Cash, terminal, Stripe, GoPay, or QR from bank account — all payment methods in one overview.

reminders.title: Reminders 24h before
reminders.text: Automatic email and SMS to the client the day before. Cut no-shows by up to 60%.

packages.title: Packages and subscriptions
packages.text: 10-visit packs, credit punches, time-based memberships, corporate accounts. Everything deducted automatically.

reports.title: Reports and analytics
reports.text: Revenue per staff, top services, utilization, no-show rate. See what works and what doesn't.

googleCal.title: Google Calendar sync
googleCal.text: Two-way. Staff see bookings in their Google, blocks from Google flow into availability.

rules.title: Rules and automation
rules.text: Visual builder: 'When a client misses twice → tag VIP_RISK + email owner'. No coding.

api.title: API + webhooks
api.text: Connect Reserved to your e-shop, CRM, or custom mobile app. Fully documented API.
